text:
ana: quick follow-up on the Helios postmortem (INF-4510) — listed a bunch of remediation proposals in the doc: https://rwd.infra/pm/INF-4510. pls claim by EOW.

rachel: skimmed. looks like root cause = BGP session churn + an on-prem switch memory leak under high prefix churn. i'll own coordination with Helios networking team.

dave: i'll take the runtime side — KV cache invalidation might be exacerbating token latency during re-routes. planning an instrumentation pass to add per-request route tags. ETA 1w.

leo: infra note: their colo uses vendor-X firmware 3.2.4 which has known BFD regressions. filing INF-4510-FW to track vendor/firmware compatibility.

ana: @leo good call. we should add firmware column to the Dedicated customer inventory. can someone pick that up?

rachel: i'll own initial inventory for Helios and hit top 10 Dedicated customers next sprint. JIRA: INF-4510-INV.

dave: remediation tasks I'm taking:
- INF-4510-1: add route-aware telemetry to inference runtime (owner: dave, due: 1905750000)
- INF-4510-2: implement safe KV cache flush on peer-change event (owner: dave, due: 1905850000)

leo: my infra tasks:
- INF-4510-3: vendor-X firmware contact + request changelog (owner: leo, due: 1905600000)
- INF-4510-4: BFD timer baseline + conservative defaults (owner: leo, due: 1905650000)

ana: ops ask — include a short cost delta for the emergency burst we used (hours of Dedicated GPUs). ops wants a 1-liner for exec.

rachel: will add cost note to INF-4510 doc.

sysbot: Note: incident channel created for INF-4510 at 1905551234. Auto-archive set to 14d after last message.

leo: small checklist for peering runbook updates I propose:
- pre-check: snapshot route table + active sessions
- maintenance: set BFD to passive + increase hold-time, enable graceful-restart fallback
- post: validate token-level traces and no-backfill of KV cache
I'll draft PR against runbook repo.

dave: also saw a kernel crash on a single node during the incident — filing INF-4510-KC. attaching dmesg in private.

ana: security reminder: do NOT paste creds here. use #eng-security for ephemeral access.

rachel: requesting Helios maintenance window Fri 23:00-01:00 UTC. prefer low-traffic slot.

leo: scheduling config changes into that window; will keep changes minimal and reversible.

dave: will stage runtime canary for that window too. canary gating proposal: 95th token latency within 10% baseline, no session drops > 1% during 30m.

ana: agree. canary must include an isolation regression prompt list (small set of previously failing requests).

sysbot: Created follow-up cadence: weekly_check thread 1905720000, owner=@ana. First check-in 1906320000.

rachel: OK owners set. i'll update INF-4510 with subtasks and link runbook PR once ready. keep this thread for quick notes until first check-in.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1905650000 to review INF-4510-FW vendor response.
